name: Irving Mall
summary: Irving Mall is a long-standing, bi-level enclosed shopping center in Irving, Texas, featuring department store anchors, a cinema, and a food court. This traditional regional mall serves the western Dallas area with a diverse mix of retail, dining, and entertainment options for families and value-oriented shoppers.
demographics: Irving Mall attracts a diverse, middle-income demographic primarily from the Irving and western Dallas metropolitan area, with a strong representation of families and Hispanic households reflecting the local community composition. The trade area serves a mix of value-conscious shoppers and families seeking convenient access to department stores, entertainment, and dining options. Typical visitors range from young families with children to middle-aged adults, with household incomes spanning lower-middle to middle class ranges, drawn by the mall's accessible price points and family-friendly amenities including the cinema and food court.
description: Irving Mall stands as a long-established shopping destination in the heart of Irving, Texas, serving the western Dallas metropolitan area since its opening. This bi-level enclosed regional mall offers a traditional indoor shopping experience anchored by department stores and complemented by a diverse mix of retail tenants, dining options in its food court, and entertainment including a cinema. The mall's convenient location at 3880 Irving Mall provides easy access for families and shoppers throughout the Irving community and surrounding areas. With its climate-controlled environment and variety of stores, Irving Mall continues to serve as a gathering place for the local community, offering everything from fashion and accessories to entertainment and dining under one roof. The center maintains its role as a reliable shopping destination with extended hours and amenities that cater to the needs of value-conscious families and diverse shoppers in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex.
